note: Settlements are classified by population density and size, using harmonized definitions across countries ([Degree of Urbanisation Framework](https://human-settlement.emergency.copernicus.eu/degurba.php)). GDP per capita is expressed in [international-$](#dod:int_dollar_abbreviation) at 2011 prices.
title: Share of population living in cities, towns and suburbs vs. GDP per capita
subtitle: Estimated share of the population living in urban areas (the sum of [cities](#dod:cities-degurba)  and [towns and suburbs](#dod:towns-degurba)). GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
